blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a “ think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors " paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions.
These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning. Code is available at https://github.com/TabGuigui/GeoCoTDrive .

远景-语言-行动(VLA)模式已成为自主驱动的有希望的模式。 然而,现有的VLA模型仍然有根本的不匹配:驱动动作需要精确的3D几何提示,而视觉语言的理解和推理则主要在2D语义空间进行. 在本文中,我们提出GeoCoTDrive,这是一个清晰的几何思维链框架,以规划导向的方式为几何学打下基础. GeoCoTDrive遵循“先用2D思考,先用专用的3D前缀驱动”范式。 它首先根据决定关键提示的2D区域进行采样,然后通过采样特性从被禁区内的几何地基模型取回本地的3D前兆.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been increasingly adopted in autonomous driving for question answering Yang et al. (2023) ; Hu et al. (2025a) ; Qian et al. (2024) ; Sima et al. (2024) ; Marcu et al. (2024) , scene understanding Jiang et al. (2024) ; Xie et al. (2025) ; Cui et al. (2025) ; Tian et al. (2025) ; Ding et al. (2024) , and end-to-end planning Wang et al. (2025b) ; Fu et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025b) ; Han et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025c) ; Zhou et al. (2025c) . These efforts collectively demonstrate that natural language can provide an effective interface for structured supervision, interpretable decision making, and planning-oriented reasoning. However, a fundamental mismatch remains in VLM-based end-to-end autonomous driving: the target action space is inherently geometric, whereas the intermediate reasoning space of VLMs is largely semantic and lacks explicit geometric cues.

blocks.en: Unlike prior methods that inject global geometric representations through implicit feature fusion, we propose GeoCoTDrive , an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. As shown in Fig. 1 , GeoCoTDrive follows a “ think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors ” paradigm. It first leverages the reasoning capability of VLMs to identify sparse 2D regions corresponding to local decision-critical cues, then retrieves dedicated 3D geometric priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These geometry tokens are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation.
blocks.zh: 与以前通过隐含地物聚变注入全球几何表示的方法不同,我们提出GeoCoTDrive,即一个清晰的几何线条思维框架,以规划导向的方式来为几何作基础. 如图1所示,GeoCoTDrive遵循“先用2D思考,先用专用3D前缀驱动”的范式。 它首先利用VLMs的推理能力,确定与本地决定关键提示相对应的稀有2D区域,再从被禁区内的几何地基模型中通过采样特征来取出专用3D几何前缀. 这些几何符号被放入自旋上下文,以支持轨迹生成.

blocks.en: To enable explicit planning-oriented geometry grounding, we introduce planning-relevant grounding , a new task for end-to-end planning. Unlike conventional object-level grounding, which is typically built upon human-annotated objects with explicit semantic categories, planning-relevant grounding aims to identify region-level cues that directly affect the ego vehicle’s future behavior. These cues go beyond foreground objects and include lane boundaries, conflict regions, occluded areas, and other local spatial constraints that govern planning. By shifting the grounding target from semantically defined objects to decision-critical regions, this task encourages the model to focus on the regions that are relevant to ego planning. Based on this formulation, we construct a semi-automatic annotation pipeline, yielding PlanningGrounding , a VQA-style grounding dataset containing 146K planning-relevant grounding annotations.

blocks.en: Given a front-view image, a driving command, and the ego status, GeoCoTDrive first autoregressively generates planning-relevant grounding results, localizing 2D regions that capture decision-critical cues. Meanwhile, the same image is encoded by a frozen geometric foundation model to produce dense geometric features. The generated grounding coordinates are then used to sample region-level geometric features, which are projected into the language-token space and interleaved back into the autoregressive context as localized geometry tokens. Conditioned on both the 2D reasoning trace and the retrieved 3D priors, GeoCoTDrive continues autoregressive decoding to output the future ego trajectory. During training, the grounding stage is supervised by PlanningGrounding annotations, while the planning stage is supervised by expert trajectories. During inference, both stages are executed sequentially in the same autoregressive pipeline.
blocks.zh: 鉴于前视图像,驱动指令,以及自负状态,GeoCoTDrive首先自发地生成与规划相关的地基结果,将捕捉决策关键提示的2D区域本地化. 同时,同一张图像被一个被冻结的几何地基模型所编码来产生密集几何特征. 所生成的地平面坐标随后被用来取样区域级几何地平面特征,这些地平面被投射到语言-token空间,并被放回自递回上下文中作为局部几何地平面符号. GeoCoTDrive在2D推理追踪和检索到的3D前科上都附加条件,继续自递解码以输出出未来的自负轨迹. 在培训期间,地平线由规划轮廓说明监督,而规划阶段则由专家轨道监督. 在推论期间,两个阶段都在同一自旋管道中相继执行.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves performance across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks. By explicitly grounding planning-relevant regions and retrieving dedicated local 3D features, GeoCoTDrive enhances both trajectory accuracy and safety-critical planning metrics.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,GeoCoTDrive在多个端到端自主驱动基准上不断提高性能. GeoCoTDrive通过明确定位与规划有关的区域并检索专门的当地立体功能,提高了轨迹精确度和安全关键规划指标。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework for VLA-based end-to-end autonomous driving. It follows a “think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors” paradigm to bridge semantic reasoning and planning. • We formulate planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local decision-critical cues directly affecting ego planning, and construct PlanningGrounding, a VQA-style grounding dataset with 146K annotations. • We introduce an autoregressive geometry retrieval mechanism that samples localized 3D features from a geometric foundation model according to predicted grounding regions and interleaves them into the generation context for trajectory prediction.

blocks.en: 4 Planning-oriented Grounding Dataset
blocks.zh: 4 面向规划的地基数据集

blocks.en: End-to-end driving requires models to identify not only semantic objects, but also local regions that directly affect ego planning. Conventional object-level grounding is category-driven and may overlook planning-critical spatial cues such as conflict areas, occluded regions, and dense agent clusters. To address this limitation, we formulate planning-relevant grounding, which aims to localize a compact set of decision-critical regions conditioned on the driving scene.
blocks.zh: 端到端驱动需要模型不仅识别语义对象,而且识别直接影响自我规划的局部地区. 常规物体平地定位是由类别驱动的,可能忽略了规划关键空间提示,如冲突地区、隐蔽地和密集物剂集群等。 为了克服这一限制,我们制定了与规划相关的基准,目的是将一套紧凑的以驾驶场为条件的决定关键区域本地化。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , each annotation sample is constructed from a front-view driving image, ego status, and a high-level driving command. A planning-oriented prompt is used to guide Gemini-3.1 Team et al. (2023) to identify the regions most relevant to the ego decision and assign each region to a planning-related category. The generated outputs are parsed into bounding boxes and category-reasoning pairs, followed by automatic format validation and human verification to ensure box validity and planning relevance. To cover diverse driving scenarios and benchmark settings, the raw driving data is collected from nuScenes Caesar et al. (2020) , NAVSIM Dauner et al. (2024) , and Bench2Drive Jia et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 如图3所显示,每个注释样本都是由前视驱动图像,自负状态,以及高级驱动指令所构建的. 以规划为导向的提示用于指导双子座3.1 Team等人(2023年)确定与自我决定最相关的区域,并将每个区域划入与规划有关的类别. 所产生的产出分为捆绑框和分类理由对等,然后是自动格式验证和人力核查,以确保箱的有效性和规划相关性。 为了涵盖不同的驾驶情景和基准设置,原始驾驶数据来自nuScenes Caesar等人(2020年)、NAVSIM Dauner等人(2024年)和Bench2Drive Jia等人(2024年)。

blocks.en: Following this semi-automatic annotation pipeline, we construct PlanningGrounding, a VQA-style grounding dataset with 146K annotations. The annotations cover five planning-related categories: critical-object , road-boundary , conflict-area , occluded-unknown-area , and dense-object-area . The first two categories are closely related to object- and map-centric annotations commonly used in existing driving VLM/VLA datasets Wang et al. (2025b) ; Fu et al. (2025) , and therefore constitute a large proportion of the dataset. Beyond these conventional cues, PlanningGrounding further provides region-level annotations for planning-critical structures, including conflict-area, dense-object-area, and occluded-unknown-area. In addition, 0.6K manually refined samples are provided as the test set of the PlanningGrounding benchmark. For more information about this dataset, please refer to the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 在这个半自动注解管道之后,我们构建了"规划环绕"(Planning Grounding),一个VQA型地基数据集,有146K注释. 说明涵盖五个与规划有关的类别:关键目标、道路边界、冲突地区、未定区和密集目标地区。 前两类与现有驱动VLM/VLA数据集(2025b)所常用的以对象和地图为中心的说明密切相关;Fu等(2025),因此构成数据集的一大部分. 除了这些传统提示外,规划环绕还提供了规划关键结构的区域一级说明,包括冲突地区、密集对象区和无人区。 此外,还提供了0.6K手动改进的样本,作为规划环绕基准的测试集. 关于本数据集的更多信息,请参见附录.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验装置

blocks.en:
We evaluate the end-to-end planning performance on three autonomous driving benchmarks: nuScenes Caesar et al. (2020) , NAVSIM Dauner et al. (2024) and Bench2Drive Jia et al. (2024) . For nuScenes, we report open-loop planning performance using L2 distance error, collision rate, and intersection rate.
For NAVSIM, we adopt the Predictive Driver Model Score (PDMS) as the closed-loop planning metric, which consists of five sub-scores: no-at-fault collisions (NC), drivable area compliance (DAC), time-to-collision (TTC), comfort (Comf.), and ego progress (EP).
For Bench2Drive, we follow the official closed-loop evaluation protocol and report driving score (DS), success rate (SR).
Together, these metrics provide a comprehensive assessment of planning accuracy, safety, comfort, and progress.
blocks.zh:
我们根据三个自主驾驶基准评价端到端的规划业绩:nuScenes Caesar等人(2020年)、NAVSIM Dauner等人(2024年)和Bench2Drive Jia等人(2024年)。 对于nuScenes,我们使用L2距离误差,相撞率和相交率来报告开放规划性能.
就NAVSIM而言,我们采用预测性驱动模型分数(PDMS)作为闭路规划衡量标准,该分数由五个分分数组成:无过失相撞(NC),可驾驶区域合规(DAC),相接时间(TTC),舒适(Comf)和自负进步(EP).
对于Bench2Drive,我们遵循官方的闭路评估协议,并报告驾驶分数(DS),成功率(SR).
这些衡量标准共同对规划的准确性、安全性、舒适性和进展进行了全面评估。

blocks.en: For planning-relevant grounding, we further evaluate GeoCoTDrive on the manually refined PlanningGrounding test set, which contains 0.6K samples and measures the model’s ability to localize decision-critical regions before trajectory generation. The grounding performance is evaluated using Recall@N, average precision (AP), and mean intersection-over-union (mIoU).
blocks.zh: 关于与规划有关的地基问题,我们进一步评估GeoCoTDrive手动改进的 " 规划环绕测试集 " ,其中包含0.6K个样本,并衡量模型在轨迹生成之前将决策关键区域本地化的能力。 地平面性能使用Recall@N,平均精度(AP)和平均相交-over-union(mIoU)来评价.

blocks.en: GeoCoTDrive is instantiated with different base VLMs across benchmarks to follow the standard configurations of prior baseline methods. For nuScenes and Bench2Drive, we adopt LLaVA-1.5-7B as the base VLM, following OmniDrive Wang et al. (2025b) and ORION Fu et al. (2025) . For NAVSIM, we use Qwen2.5-VL as the base VLM to align with recent VLA-based planning methods Li et al. (2025c) ; Luo et al. (2026) . For the trajectory decoder, nuScenes and NAVSIM use autoregressive text decoding, where future trajectory coordinates are generated as language action tokens. On Bench2Drive, we follow the diffusion planner design in ORION Fu et al. (2025) to produce executable trajectories. This heterogeneous setup demonstrates that GeoCoTDrive can be integrated with different VLM backbones and trajectory-generation heads, highlighting its generality across diverse autonomous driving benchmarks.
blocks.zh: GeoCoTDrive通过不同基准的VLM进行即时配置,以遵循先前基准方法的标准配置. 对于nuScenes和Bench2Drive,我们采用LLaVA-1.5-7B作为基础VLM,沿用了OmniDrive Wang等 (2025b)和Orion Fu等 (2025). 对于NAVSIM,我们使用Quen2.5-VL作为基础VLM,以配合最近以VLA为基础的规划方法Li等 (2025c).;Luo等 (2026). 对于轨迹解码器,nuScenes和NAVSIM使用自旋式文本解码,其中未来的轨迹坐标被生成为语言动作符号. 在Bench2Drive上,我们遵循Orion Fu等人(2025年)的推广计划设计,以产生可执行的轨迹. 这种不同的设置表明,GeoCoTDrive可以与不同的VLM主干线和轨迹生成头相融合,突出其跨越不同自主驱动基准的通俗性.

blocks.en: For geometric feature extraction, we evaluate DepthAnythingV3 Lin et al. (2025) and VGGT Wang et al. (2025a) , which provide dense depth-aware and 3D-aware feature maps for localized geometry retrieval. The geometric foundation model is kept frozen. GeoCoTDrive is trained in two stages. In Stage I, we update the vision encoder and LLM with full QA training to adapt the VLM to autonomous-driving scenarios. In Stage II, we freeze the vision encoder and optimize the LLM together with the geometric alignment head, enabling localized geometric features to be aligned with the language space and interleaved into the planning context. More training details are provided in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 对于几何特征提取,我们评价了DepthAnythingV3 Lin等(2025)和VGGT Wang等(2025a),它们为局部几何检索提供了密集的深度认知和3D-认知特征地图. 几何地基模型被冻结。 GeoCoTDrive分两个阶段受训. 在第一阶段,我们用完整的QA训练来更新视觉编码器和LLM,使VLM适应自主驾驶情景. 在第二阶段,我们冻结了视觉编码器,并优化了LLM与几何对接头,使本地几何特征能够与语言空间相接并融入规划背景。 附录中提供了更多的培训细节。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the open-loop planning results on nuScenes. GeoCoTDrive achieves competitive performance among VLA-based methods and shows favorable safety-related performance. Table 2 further evaluates GeoCoTDrive on the NAVSIM navtest set. Compared with the Qwen2.5-VL baseline, GeoCoTDrive achieves a modest PDMS improvement and improves safety-related sub-metrics. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework for VLA-based end-to-end autonomous driving. GeoCoTDrive first grounds planning-relevant 2D regions, retrieves localized 3D geometric priors from a frozen geometric foundation model, and interleaves these geometry tokens into the autoregressive context for trajectory generation. We further introduce PlanningGrounding, a VQA-style grounding dataset that provides region-level supervision for decision-critical spatial cues. Experiments on nuScenes, NAVSIM, and Bench2Drive demonstrate that GeoCoTDrive improves planning performance, highlighting the importance of coupling planning-oriented 2D reasoning with localized 3D geometric priors for safer autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍GeoCoTDrive,这是一个基于VLA的端到端自主驱动的清晰几何思维链框架。 GeoCoTDrive第一地规划与2D相关区域,从被冻结的几何地基模型中取出本地化的3D几何前兆,并将这些几何地标符号放入轨道生成的自旋上下文. 我们进一步引入了 " 规划环绕 " 系统,这是一个VQA式地基数据集,为决策关键空间提示提供区域一级的监督。 关于nuScenes,NAVSIM,和Bench2Drive的实验表明,GeoCoTDrive改进了规划性能,突出了将面向规划的2D推理与本地的3D几何前科结合起来对于更安全的自主驾驶的重要性.

blocks.en: Recent autonomous-driving VQA datasets have significantly advanced language-based scene understanding, reasoning, and planning. However, the grounding supervision of these datasets is usually designed around object-level perception annotations, rather than explicit region-level cues related to the ego vehicle’s planning demand. We summarize the main differences in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 最近自主驾驶的VQA数据集在语言基础上的场景理解,推理,和规划上都有显著的进步. 然而,这些数据集的地基监督通常围绕物体层面的感知说明,而不是与自负载体的规划需求相关的明确的区域层面提示来设计. 我们总结了表8的主要差异。

blocks.en: Unlike conventional object-centric grounding, PlanningGrounding is designed to identify the regions that most directly affect the ego vehicle’s planning decision. This distinction is important because the planning decisions are often constrained not only by individual traffic participants, but also by local road boundaries, conflict driving zones, or uncertain regions. Therefore, PlanningGrounding complements existing driving VQA resources by providing explicit, command-aware grounding supervision for planning-oriented reasoning.
blocks.zh: 与传统的以物体为中心的地平线不同,“规划环绕”旨在确定最直接地影响自我载体规划决定的区域。 这种区分很重要,因为规划决定不仅往往受到个别交通参与者的限制,而且受到当地道路边界、冲突驱动区或不确定区域的限制。 因此, " 规划环绕 " 通过为面向规划的推理提供明确、有指挥意识的基础监督,补充了现有的驱动VQA资源。

blocks.en: Appendix B Analysis of PlanningGrounding
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: PlanningGrounding is constructed to supervise explicit planning-oriented visual grounding. Given a front-view driving image, driving command, and optional ego status, the task is to localize the most decision-critical regions that affect the planning decision. Each grounding region is assigned one of five categories: critical-object , road-boundary , conflict-area , occluded-unknown-area , and dense-object-area . These categories cover both object-level and region-level spatial cues required for safe trajectory generation.
blocks.zh: 规划围观是为了监督明确面向规划的视觉地面。 鉴于前视驱动图像,驱动指令,以及可选的自负状态,任务在于将影响规划决定的最关键决策区域本地化. 每个搁浅区域被划分为五类之一:临界目标、道路边界、冲突地区、未明地区、密集目标地区。 这些类别包括安全轨道生成所需的物体级和地级空间提示。

blocks.en: • Critical object denotes a single key entity that directly affects the ego vehicle’s near-term speed, yielding behavior, stopping decision, or trajectory selection. Typical examples include a leading vehicle requiring deceleration, a pedestrian near the ego path, a cyclist around the turning area, a traffic cone blocking the lane, or a traffic light/sign that immediately constrains the maneuver. An object is annotated as critical only when its influence is directly tied to the current command and local planning decision. • Road boundary refers to an immediate static boundary that constrains the ego vehicle’s local drivable space. This category includes lane edges, curbs, barriers, dividers, cone lines, road edges, and other visible structures that define the lateral feasible region. • Conflict area denotes a compact local region where the ego vehicle’s intended path may interact with other traffic flows or potential agent motions, such as a merge point, crossing zone, or turn conflict entrance. Unlike critical object, this category describes a spatial zone rather than a single entity, encouraging the model to reason about where potential interactions may occur. • Occluded unknown area denotes a region with meaningful uncertainty caused by occlusion, blind spots, or blocked visibility. Such regions commonly appear behind parked vehicles, large trucks, roadside buildings, vegetation, or sharp turns. Although no explicit object may be visible, these regions can still require conservative planning, such as slowing down before entering a blind spot or preparing to yield. • Dense object area represents a compact cluster of objects whose collective presence affects planning. Examples include a group of pedestrians, a queue of vehicles, a cluster of cones, or multiple parked vehicles narrowing the drivable corridor. This category is used when the planning-relevant cue is better represented by a region containing multiple nearby entities rather than by a single object.

blocks.en: Appendix C Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节

blocks.en: GeoCoTDrive adopts different VLM backbones according to the benchmark setting. For nuScenes and Bench2Drive, LLaVA-1.5-7B is used as the base VLM, while Qwen2.5-VL-3B is used for NAVSIM. Across all settings, the model takes the front-view image, ego status, and high-level navigation command as input, and autoregressively generates planning-relevant grounding results followed by the planning answer.
blocks.zh: GeoCoTDrive根据基准设置采用不同的VLM主干线. 对于nuScenes和Bench2Drive,LLaVA-1.5-7B被用作基站VLM,而Quen2.5-VL-3B则用于NAVSIM. 在所有设置中,模型都以前视图像,自负状态和高水平导航指令作为输入,并自动地生成与规划相关的地基结果,然后是规划答案.

blocks.en: Two geometric foundation models are used to extract geometric priors: Depth Anything V3 with the METRIC-LARGE configuration and the vanilla version of VGGT. Both models are kept frozen. For each model, the feature map from the last backbone layer is used as the source of geometric tokens. Given a grounding region, localized geometric features are sampled from this feature map and projected into the language embedding space.
blocks.zh: 两个几何基础模型用于提取几何前缀: 深度Anything V3与METRIC-LARGE配置和香草版VGGT. 两个模型都被冻结。 对于每个模型,取自上个主干层的特征图被作为几何符号的来源. 鉴于一个地平面区域,从这个地平面图上取出局部几何特征并投放到语言嵌入空间.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Two-stage training structure of GeoCoTDrive. Stage-I adapts the vision-language backbone to autonomous-driving QA and planning knowledge, while Stage-II trains GeoCoT planning.
blocks.zh: 表10:GeoCoTDrive的两级培训结构。 第一阶段使视觉语言的主干线适应自主驾驶的QA和规划知识,而第二阶段则训练GeoCoT规划.

blocks.en: The training process contains two stages. The first stage performs full QA training to adapt the VLM to autonomous-driving knowledge. Specifically, nuScenes uses OmniDrive together with PlanningGrounding, NAVSIM uses NAVSIM-Traj together with PlanningGrounding, and Bench2Drive uses B2D-Chat together with PlanningGrounding. In this stage, both the vision encoder and the LLM are updated, allowing the model to acquire driving-related visual understanding and planning knowledge. The model is trained for 3 epochs with a cosine learning-rate scheduler, where the peak learning rate is set to 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh: 培训过程包括两个阶段。 第一阶段进行全面的质量保证培训,使VLM适应自主驾驶知识. 具体来说,nuScens使用OmniDrive与"规划Grounding",NAVSIM使用NAVSIM-Traj与"规划Grounding",而Beach2Drive则使用B2D-Chat与"规划Grounding". 在这个阶段,视觉编码器和LLM都进行了更新,使模型能够获得与驱动相关的视觉理解和规划知识. 该模型为3个有余弦学习率排程器的时代所训练,其中最高峰学习率被设定为4×10−5 4\times 10×5}.

blocks.en: The second stage performs geometry-interleaved planning training. Planning answers and grounding annotations are merged into a single-turn conversation, where the model is required to first generate planning-relevant grounding results and then predict the planning trajectory. A special token <GEO_COT> is inserted after the grounding output as a placeholder for geometric reasoning. During training, the ground-truth grounding boxes are used as the sampler input to retrieve localized geometric features. The sampled geometric tokens are then interleaved into the autoregressive sequence at the <GEO_COT> position, enabling subsequent trajectory prediction to condition on localized 3D priors. This stage is also trained for 3 epochs with a cosine learning-rate scheduler, where the peak learning rate is set to 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} . For the Bench2Drive benchmark, we follow the planner implementation of ORION. We remove the detection and mapping head, and use the VLM tokens and localized geometric tokens from the front-view image as conditions for the planner. All experiments are conducted with 8 A800 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段进行几何-间距规划培训。 规划答案和地平面说明被合并为一回合对话,其中需要模型首先生成与规划相关的地平面结果并进而预测规划轨迹. 在定位输出后插入一个特殊的符号 " GEO_COT " ,作为几何推理的占位符。 在训练期间,地面真地取地箱被用作取地几何特征的取样器输入. 然后在<GEO_COT>位置将所抽样的几何符号放入自旋序列,使随后的轨迹预测能以本地化的3D前作为条件。 这一阶段也为3个有余弦学习率排程器的时代所训练,其中最高峰学习率被设定为2×10−5 2.\times 10×5}. 对于Bench2Drive基准,我们跟踪Orion的规划者的执行情况。 我们删除了探测和映射头,并使用前视图像中的VLM标志和局部几何标志作为规划者的条件. 所有实验都用8个A800GPU进行.

blocks.en: The inference process follows the same question format as training. The model first autoregressively generates grounding results. Once the <GEO_COT> token is generated, the predicted grounding boxes are parsed and used to sample localized geometric features from the geometric foundation model. These resulting geometric tokens are interleaved into the context, after which the model continues autoregressive decoding to generate the final trajectory prediction.

blocks.en: Table 11 studies the sampling grid size for localized geometry retrieval. A small grid may miss local structures, while an overly dense grid introduces redundancy. The results show that a moderate grid size achieves the best trade-off between geometric detail and token efficiency.
blocks.zh: 表11研究了局部几何检索的采样网格大小. 一个小的网格可能会错过局部结构,而过于密集的网格则引入了冗余. 结果显示,适度的网格尺寸在几何细节和象征性效率之间实现最佳取舍.

blocks.en: Table 12 studies the contribution of the two-stage training strategy. Stage-I alone provides basic autonomous-driving QA and planning knowledge, while Stage-II alone enables geometry-interleaved planning. Combining both training stages achieves the best planning performance across all metrics, indicating that driving knowledge adaptation and localized geometry conditioning are complementary for end-to-end planning.
blocks.zh: 表12研究了两阶段培训战略的贡献。 仅第一阶段就提供基本的自主驾驶质量保证和规划知识,而第二阶段单靠第二阶段就能够进行几何-互开式规划。 将两个培训阶段结合起来,就能实现所有衡量标准的最佳规划业绩,表明驱动知识的适应和局部几何条件对端到端的规划是相辅相成的。

blocks.en: We evaluate GeoCoTDrive on NAVSIM turning scenarios, where planning requires reasoning about road geometry and surrounding agents. As shown in Table 13 , GeoCoTDrive improves PDMS for both left and right turns, with gains across NC, DAC, and EP. These results support the effectiveness of grounded geometric priors in planning under local spatial constraints.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GeoCoTDrive在NAVSIM变换情景上,其中规划需要对道路几何和周围物剂进行推理. 如表13所显示,GeoCoTDrive改进了左转和右转的PDMS,在NC、DAC和EP方面都有所收获。 这些结果支持了本地空间限制下基于几何学前科规划的有效性.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制

blocks.en: GeoCoTDrive primarily relies on front-view images without explicit multi-view or temporal modeling, limiting its ability to account for side and rear traffic, prolonged occlusions, and interaction histories. Localized geometry retrieval also depends on grounding accuracy. The incorrect or incomplete regions may yield less relevant geometric cues and impair trajectory prediction. Future work will extend GeoCoTDrive to multi-view and temporal settings and improve grounding robustness.
blocks.zh: GeoCoTDrive主要依赖前视图像,没有明确的多视点或时间模型,限制了其核算侧面和后相通,长期被隔离,以及互动历史的能力. 本地化几何检索也取决于地基的准确性. 不正确或不完整的区域可能产生不太相关的几何提示并会损害轨迹预测。 今后的工作将扩大GeoCoTDrive的范围,使之包括多视角和时间环境,并增强基础稳健性。
